protocol: Screen CUDA workers 2,4,8,16 once; select fastest exact complete batch. One warmup each, three alternating measured pairs vs CPU16. Promote only >=5% median improvement, >=2/3 faster pairs and all correctness gates. No optional additional timing repetitions.
